feeds.title: Kelly in the City
feeds.description: Kelly in the City is a Preppy Chicago Life, Style, and Fashion Blog. My name is Kelly Larkin, and this blog is where I document my life. You'll find a whole lot of fashion- and home-related content on Kelly in the City.

feeds.title: Doused in Pink
feeds.description: Doused in Pink is a Chicago fashion blog featuring everyday, effortless style, clean beauty, and DIY home decor. I'm Jill, and I'm a corporate recruiter by day, and my blog is my creative outlet in this little space of the internet.

feeds.title: Later Ever After
feeds.description: Later Ever After is a Chicago based life and style blog focused on women defining their own life timeline. I always knew my happily ever after would come one day, probably later than most, and guess what, it's here; Later Ever After!

feeds.title: GOLD COAST GIRL
feeds.description: A Chicago-based fashion and lifestyle guide. My name is Samantha and I created this blog as a creative outlet for me to express my love for all things related to fashion, food, fitness, home decor, beauty, and more recently motherhood.

feeds.title: The Fox & She » Style
feeds.description: I'm Blair Staky, I'm a web designer, SEO nerd, artist, mama and wife. Here I share little tidbits of things I love, our family's favorite recipes, random musings, peeks into our life and my favorite products.

feeds.title: Dollface Diaries
feeds.description: Diary of Chicago based blogger Jessa Lynn, sharing tips on travel, petite fashion, beauty, and positive living. Anna shares life advice, trend forecasting, travel inspiration, and her favorite places in the beautiful city of Chicago where she happily calls home.

feeds.title: Abbie Kay
feeds.description: My name is Abbie Milligan and this blog is a collection of everything I love: everyday life, fashion, food, beauty products & more. I needed something different in my life and so abbiekay.com was born. I am a Nebraska Native who is currently loving life in Chicago.

feeds.title: Jess Keys
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jess, and this site is a real girl approach to living your best life! I share my absolute favorite products, style tips that make you feel confident instead of self-conscious, practical beauty favorites, and just general life stuff from travel to relationships, motherhood, and more coming from a girl with personal experience, just living through it.

feeds.title: Visions of Vogue
feeds.description: Visions of Vogue is a popular Chicago lifestyle and fashion blog written by Jenna who started it to share her passion for fashion and travels. While working in the finance industry, Jenna started Visions of Vogue as a creative outlet. She works full-time at her desk job and spends time on the blog when she's not in her cubicle.

feeds.title: Fountainof30
feeds.description: Hi, We're Lauren and Carol and we believe in growing younger in mind, spirit and beauty. Fountain of 30 is an anti-aging style, beauty, health and travel site dedicated to women over 40 who feel 30 and will do whatever it takes to keep looking 30.

feeds.title: Style Charade
feeds.description: Jennifer Lake is a Chicago blogger covering fashion, travel, home design, beauty, and lifestyle. Colorful style mixed with street art and murals. In 2015, she launched Style Charade as a small corner of the Internet to call her own. After spending her career helping others build their brands, she wanted a space that felt representative of the lens through which she seen the world.

feeds.title: Natalie in the City Blog
feeds.description: Natalie in the City is a blog that focuses on fashion for the Petite Plus Size woman. Natalie Craig is a fashionista exploring Chicago and sharing her fashion adventures.

feeds.title: Chicago Looks Blog
feeds.description: A Chicago fashion street style blog that features a selection of cool looks seen in the windy city. The website has been featuring some of the city's best styles since 2009. Come for the street style, stay for all our local fashion scene has to offer.

feeds.title: Chicago Fashion Incubator Blog
feeds.description: Our blog features works and articles of the designers from Chicago Fashion Incubator. The Chicago Fashion Incubator at Macy's on State Street provides emerging Chicago-based designers in residence with the resources, business acumen, and mentoring to launch their careers in fashion.

feeds.title: Style Plus Curves
feeds.description: Style Plus Curves is a Chicago plus size fashion blog celebrating plus size style, clothes, and shopping. I share curvy girl inspiration and plus size blogger adventures in Chicago! I'm Amber, the plus size blogger behind the Chicago plus size fashion blog, Style Plus Curves. I believe in the power of fashion and its very real impact on your day-to-day life.

feeds.title: A Lily Love Affair » Style
feeds.description: A Chicago based lifestyle blog by Anna Baun covering style, recipes, travel & more! To Anna, Chicago is a magical place full of sparkle and energy, culture, architecture, food, music, style and amazing people.

feeds.title: Something Whitty
feeds.description: A fashion + lifestyle blog written by Whitney Buha, Something Whitty covers fashion & beauty tips, travel guides, home decor, and much more. Whitney works full time in marketing, but loves to share her passion for all things fashion, food, travel and beauty.

feeds.title: Alice & Wonder Blog
feeds.description: The Rabbit Hole blog features our brand's recent updates, and other inspirations and updates on Chicago. Alice & Wonder is a Chicago-based shop curating pretty fun things from apparel to gifts. We bring you the good stuff: everything from those hard-to-find gems you can't live without to the classic brands you know and trust.

feeds.title: Red Soles and Red Wine » Style
feeds.description: Red Soles and Red Wine is a personal style, travel, beauty and foodie blog that started off as a hobby and a way to meet people in Chicago. Jennifer, the author of the blog, is a full time digital influencer and a mom of two boys.

feeds.title: Dapper Professional Blog
feeds.description: Dapper Professional is the largest men's fashion Instagram account in Chicago and the blog provides in-depth information related to men's fashion. My name is Ben Rascoe and I started the Dapper Professional passion project in 2014 to help inspire men to learn how to dress better, select the right clothing for their lifestyle and find menswear products within their budget.

feeds.title: Notes From Jo
feeds.description: Notes From Jo is a blog based in Chicago. Find thoughtful inspirations for every occasion, including ideas, tips, and how-to advice on fashion, food & drink recipes, decor, gift guides, entertaining, weddings, holidays and more. My name is Joanna and I'm a lover of all things fashion and beauty, a food and wine enthusiast and have a passion for entertaining.

feeds.title: Ela Bobak Blog
feeds.description: Ela Bobak is a Chicago based fashion blogger who shares home decor, travel, family life, her dogs, beauty, tips and tricks. She previously worked as a men's model agent and now works in advertising. Majoring in Fashion Business, Ela always had a love towards fashion and loves sharing about it.

feeds.title: Wishes & Reality
feeds.description: A Chicago based lifestyle blog featuring a mix of timeless classics and modern trends. Wishes & Reality was born in 2014 and focuses and fashion, food, home and family. The author is a wife and mom of two living in suburban Chicago.

feeds.title: Bows & Sequins
feeds.description: A fashion-focused lifestyle and travel blog where you'll find posts about personal style, travel, beauty, fitness, wellness, and more. My name is Jessica and I'm kind of a coffee snob, a bit of a foodie, and a self-proclaimed cocktail connoisseur. While this blog is a big part of my life, I'm also a creative consultant and a personal stylist.

feeds.title: Sportsanista
feeds.description: Sportsanista is a Chicago fashion blog that shares affordable and accessible fashion finds, beauty tips and game-day fashion. Her blog started out as a platform for women who work in sports to gain inspiration on incorporating fashion in to their everyday.
